body.query:
query Publisher($key: ID!) {
    publisher: organization(key: $key) {
      key
      title
      description
      deleted
      created
      homepage
      numPublishedDatasets
      logoUrl: thumborLogoUrl(height: 500, width: 500, fitIn: true)

      latitude
      longitude
      address
      city
      country
      email
      phone
      postalCode
      province

      endorsingNode {
        title
      }
      endorsingNodeKey
      endorsementApproved

      installation {
        count
        results {
          key
          title
        }
      }

      contacts {
        key
        type
        firstName
        lastName
        email
        phone
        homepage
        organization
        roles
        userId
      }
    }
  }
